plugin.name: SOCOM Fireteam Bravo 3 Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)
skip.description: Skip startup intros. Restart after changing this option.
analog.description: Use the right stick for camera and aim, and the left stick for movement. Xbox-compatible controllers work with stock Windows PPSSPP’s default controls. Custom right-analog mappings remain supported. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
smoothing.description: Removes the extra smoothing of the normal camera. Stick response stays as in the original game. Requires dual analog controls; restart after changes.
loading.description: Speeds up loading screens. Restart after changes.
fov.description: Scale the normal gameplay camera’s field of view from 0.5 to 2.0. 1.0 keeps its intended angle. Aiming, binocular and scripted views keep their own angles. Changes in Plugins apply immediately; restart the emulated game after editing the file.
aspect.description: Auto follows PPSSPP's display aspect. Enter W:H or a decimal to override it (1:1 to 4:1). The 3D view keeps its vertical field of view. Changes in the Plugins menu apply immediately. Restart the emulated game after editing the file.
hudaspect.description: Auto places side-anchored HUD elements at the screen edges. A ratio keeps them in a centered box (4:3 to 32:9). World markers stay aligned with their objects. Changes in the Plugins menu apply immediately. Restart the emulated game after editing the file.
hudscale.description: Resize gameplay HUD text and artwork together (0.5 to 1.5). Menus, loading screens and scope masks keep their original canvas. Full-screen effects still cover the screen. Changes in the Plugins menu apply immediately. Restart the emulated game after editing the file.
borders.description: Keep scripted camera framing with borders. Letterbox adds top and bottom borders on narrow screens; Pillarbox adds side borders on wide screens. Both fits the complete original view. Off shows a wider horizontal view. Changes in the Plugins menu apply immediately. Restart the emulated game after editing the file.
menu.restart: Restart the emulated game to apply changed settings.
menu.save.error: Settings could not be saved. Try again.
language.description: Choose the language of the Fusion Fix menus. Changes in the Plugins menu apply immediately. Restart the emulated game after editing the file.
menu.preset.help: Vanilla keeps the original intros, controls and PSP icons. Recommended and Enhanced enable intro skipping, dual analog controls, reduced camera smoothing, faster loading and Xbox icons. Other settings keep your values.
icons.description: Replace button artwork in menus and gameplay prompts. Auto uses Xbox artwork because stock PPSSPP does not expose the connected controller family. PlayStation keeps the original PSP artwork. This changes artwork only; configure controls in PPSSPP. Changes in Plugins apply immediately; file edits require restarting the emulated game.
start.description: Continue past the title screen through the game’s own completion path. Profile creation and other real choices remain available. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
fps.description: Choose the original 30 FPS limit or 60 FPS. Gameplay uses elapsed time; effect updates, camera-shake decay and text timing follow the same clock. PPSSPP controls emulation speed and frame skipping. Changes in Plugins apply immediately; restart the emulated game after editing the file.
